description: A React component for managing and editing font sizes of text elements within a drawing scene, supporting multi-selection and step-based adjustments.

methods.name: getApplicableTextElements
methods.description: Filters and retrieves text elements or bound text elements from a list, excluding grouped elements.

methods.name: handleFontSizeChange
methods.description: Handles the change in font size, updating elements and redrawing bounding boxes accordingly.

methods.name: MultiFontSize
methods.description: React component that displays and manages font size adjustments for multiple text elements.
